```{r}
#| label: thesis-landing-hero
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
.img <- "images/thesis_cover.jpg"
if (file.exists(.img)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    '<div class="thesis-hero">
  <img class="thesis-hero-img" src="%s" alt="">
  <div class="thesis-hero-overlay"></div>
  <div class="thesis-hero-body">
    <span class="thesis-hero-eyebrow">PhD Thesis &middot; University of Waikato &middot; 2026</span>
    <h1 class="thesis-hero-title">Enhancing native freshwater crayfish habitat in invaded lake ecosystems</h1>
    <div class="thesis-hero-rule"></div>
    <span class="thesis-hero-author">Olivier V. Raven</span>
    <span class="thesis-hero-year">2026</span>
  </div>
</div>',
    knitr::image_uri(.img)
  ))
}
```
:::
